narrative.headline: Engine complaints overwhelm the 2018 Ford Escape
narrative.summary: Of 1,685 owner complaints filed with NHTSA, engine problems dominate, making up 1,057 reports (63%) on their own. Add the 336 engine-and-cooling reports (20%) and the engine is involved in over four out of five complaints. The power train is the next concern at 257 reports (15%). The engine complaints include 4 fires, 4 crashes, and 7 injuries; the power train adds 4 crashes and 6 injuries. No deaths were reported. Buyers should inspect the engine, cooling system, and transmission closely.
